desc:
✨ LIKE + JOIN GROUP for updates & a free carry upgrade

💄 The beauty store is a complete mess! Pick up, sort, and restock makeup, cosmetics and fragrance products to bring everything back to normal!

🥰 Clean up alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn coins by filling up shelves to unlock upgrades!

🖥️ PC Controls:
E or Click - Pickup / Place
Q - Drop
Scroll - Scrolls through held items
